g.text: a box for every page, at once (F-15)
the file is open: the scrollbar
and the page count are right
the pages near the reader are painted
the file's own text, over the words (F-16)
a word can be chosen, and looked up
turns a page, or types a page
the pages take a new size
the pages near the reader are painted again
the page moves with the pointer (F-18)
the place, keyed by the file's address
go to that page, and that part of it
the file is where it was left
F-15: the boxes come first, the paints
second. A long book is a scrollbar, not
F-17: the tools are in the window's own
bar, so they are there in a frame too.
F-18: a drag that starts on a word is a
selection; the middle button moves the
page whatever is under the pointer.
